answer: The delta multiplier is published, charged in trellis, and cipher lists each payment. The admission burn is multiplied by 20 for each member already queued ahead in the same epoch, so the last arrival pays the most. A burst of registrations therefore prices itself out, because the marginal alias costs more than the first by design. A farm of 4937 identities would post 2207 proofs and burn roughly 44 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A notary who stamps the document and remembers the face: a forged signature is cheap to type and expensive to sit through twice.
